V_tb.name: |V_tb|
V_tb.description: A Wave 9 CKM mop-up benchmark for |V_tb|.
V_tb.benchmark_purpose: Closes the CKM block with the final large mixing entry not covered earlier.
V_tb.citation: PDG 2024; FSOT Mathematical Key §15 / Wave 9 #1; FSOT 3.0 Cosmic Skeleton Key Thesis §15.1 CKM Matrix
V_tb.notes: Measured-reference layer populated from the thesis Wave 9 table.

Omega_r.name: Omega_r
Omega_r.description: A Wave 9 cosmology mop-up benchmark for Omega_r.
Omega_r.benchmark_purpose: Adds the radiation-density benchmark that sits outside the earlier late-universe Wave 8 focus.
Omega_r.notes: Tightened from the rounded thesis shorthand to a Planck-era central radiation-density benchmark with a nonzero tolerance.

O4_nu.name: O(4) nu
O4_nu.description: A Wave 9 critical-phenomena mop-up benchmark for O(4) nu.
O4_nu.benchmark_purpose: Captures the remaining O(4) critical exponent called out in the thesis mop-up section.
O4_nu.citation: Pelissetto and Vicari, Phys. Rep. 368, 549-727 (2002); FSOT Mathematical Key §15 / Wave 9 #3
O4_nu.notes: Tightened from the thesis shorthand to a higher-precision O(4) universality-class central value with a nonzero tolerance.

Gluon_condensate.name: Gluon condensate
Gluon_condensate.description: A Wave 9 QCD mop-up benchmark for Gluon condensate.
Gluon_condensate.benchmark_purpose: Adds the gluon-condensate benchmark so the mop-up wave still touches strong-interaction structure.
Gluon_condensate.citation: Shifman, Vainshtein, and Zakharov, Nucl. Phys. B147, 385-447 (1979); FSOT Mathematical Key §15 / Wave 9 #4
Gluon_condensate.notes: Tightened from the rounded thesis shorthand so the audit no longer treats this non-exact QCD benchmark as a zero-width target.

Mandelbrot_boundary.name: Mandelbrot boundary
Mandelbrot_boundary.description: A Wave 9 fractal or boundary-geometry mop-up benchmark for Mandelbrot boundary.
Mandelbrot_boundary.benchmark_purpose: Closes the wave with exact or near-exact fractal and boundary observables rather than only laboratory quantities.
Mandelbrot_boundary.citation: Shishikura, Ann. of Math. 147, 225-267 (1998); FSOT Mathematical Key §15 / Wave 9 #5
Mandelbrot_boundary.notes: The thesis notes this target is the exact golden-ratio identity phi + 1/phi^2 = 2.

Sierpinski_dim.name: Sierpinski dim
Sierpinski_dim.description: A Wave 9 fractal or boundary-geometry mop-up benchmark for Sierpinski dim.
Sierpinski_dim.benchmark_purpose: Closes the wave with exact or near-exact fractal and boundary observables rather than only laboratory quantities.
Sierpinski_dim.citation: Sierpinski 1915; exact Hausdorff dimension ln(3)/ln(2); FSOT Mathematical Key §15 / Wave 9 #6
Sierpinski_dim.notes: Exact self-similar dimension benchmark tightened from the thesis shorthand to ln(3)/ln(2).

Stieltjes_gamma1.name: gamma_1 (Stieltjes)
Stieltjes_gamma1.description: A Wave 9 analytic-number-theory mop-up benchmark for gamma_1 (Stieltjes).
Stieltjes_gamma1.benchmark_purpose: Adds the first Stieltjes constant to finish the remaining analytic-number-theory target in the mop-up set.
Stieltjes_gamma1.citation: NIST DLMF §5.17; FSOT Mathematical Key §15 / Wave 9 #7
